title: Functions Practice 1
statement:
Module 3 (Functions) covers: html5 forms advanced, accessibility basics, seo and meta tags, html templates and boilerplate, interactive elements, html emails and newsletters. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 1: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (HTML5 Forms Advanced).
hints: Re-read the HTML5 Forms Advanced lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
